comment: The reviewed input manifest of the CI combined lane (docs/ci-lanes.md). NOT deploy/testnet/pins.json (that is the testnet package's). scripts/ci/check-pins.sh verifies every built or downloaded component against this file and refuses a wrong pin.

ureth.note: ureth#75 merge: transaction-only gossip among the trusted peers of the shard (the lanes peer the clients with admin_addTrustedPeer, scripts/lib/reth-peers.sh)
ureth.targetedNote: the plan's targeted selectors (briefs/ci-lane-migration-plan.md section 1): any-age/batch/layout/provider vectors, system-hook ordering and gas, certified RPC/recovery, persistence. Not cargo test --workspace and no generic Ethereum suites.

contracts.note: contracts#53 merge: GovernanceParams (#50), RewardPool (#51) and the governed worst-case election gas / deployment fields (#53)

native-bridge-plugins.note: nbp#33 merge: main with the plug-in consolidation as the default path (nbp#30/#31) and the any-age driver's 'consolidated' command (#526 step 4) on top of the two-shard steering (nbp#29).

foundry.note: the version the lane's Mac runs (cast/forge 1.8.1); anyage-lane.sh requires 1.8.x

mongo.note: multi-arch index digest; the lane pulls image@digest

runner.label: ubuntu-24.04
runner.minFreeDiskNote: Measured on ubuntu-24.04 standard runners (4 CPU / 16 GB), runs 39391426570 and 39399607786: the lane's disk growth peaks at 3.88 GiB (the cold ureth build 3.79 GiB, the Go build 3.72 GiB, sources 0.97 GiB); memory peaks at 2.36 GiB (run) and 4.62 GiB (ureth build), no swap. The gate is checked by the preflight after the inputs are unpacked: 8 GiB is 2.06 times the measured peak growth, so a run twice as chatty as the measured one still fits, and it is far below the 25 GiB of the Mac default (which also covers building ureth and contracts there). A runner with less than 8 GiB free after unpacking is refused, never waved through.
runner.minFreeDiskUrethTargetedNote: Measured (run 39433678003, ubuntu-24.04 standard runner): the targeted ureth test build and run grow the disk by 11.15 GiB and use 8.21 GiB of memory (304 tests, 11.3 min sampled). The gate is 24 GiB: 2.15 times the growth, checked by scripts/ci/test-ureth.sh before it builds.

lane.note: the aggregator partition runs as two bft-shard aggregators (0x40, 0xc0); the any-age L1 token spans both and one more token is redeemed through the SDK's consolidation (#526 step 4)
lane.evmT2Note: the EVM shard's T2 in the CI lane (milliseconds; the Mac default stays 5000). After the recovery only 3 of the 4 enrolled validators run, so a round needs all three signatures and its latency is the slowest of three: measured first-UC-to-third-signature up to 14.3 s on a standard runner (bft-core#728, run 39554461091), while T2 = 5 s turned every late round into a permanent livelock. 15 s passed the combined lane with all steps; the margin over the measured tail is small, see #728.

t6.comment: T6 pins its own inputs in scripts/t6-rehearsal.sh (its defaults); they differ from the lane's on purpose and are not unified silently. check-pins.sh t6 refuses a script whose defaults differ from this record.
